content.content: 1. Necessity: the lexical rule needs the grammar for invocation shape — without a verb notion, verb-shapedness is motiveless. Fail if the edge can be dropped without loss. 2. License: no element contradicts any prerequisite. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element.
content.rationale: Lexical shape is where the elaboration meets the grammar; the gate keeps the use sound without classifying text itself.
